changeSet.author: pc
changeSet.comment: When a recruitment was created, when its allocations were first released to faculty, when faculty review was last closed and when its assignments were last published, for the Recruitment Steps diagram (issue #231). Created is backfilled from the recruitment audit trail.

sql.sql: UPDATE recruitments SET created_at = (SELECT MIN(t.changed_at) FROM recruitment_audit_trail t WHERE t.recruitment_id = recruitments.id AND t.what_changed = 'created')
